title: [spec-gap][R-12-034] Density-adaptive position beacon floor (>20 → >=300s) unimplemented; vectors orphaned
description: spec/12-apps.md:397-400 (18.2.1 MUST): when local density estimate (EstimateDensity, 02a §2a.10.3) exceeds 20, beacon interval MUST be at least 300 s regardless of motion state. Evidence: no density logic in any beacon path (grep zero in coap_location.c/.h, python beacon code, rust); estimate_density exists only in CCP (python/src/lichen/ccp.py:220); test/vectors/density_scaling.json position_beacon_rate vectors encode exactly this rule (D=21→300s) with ZERO consumers in python/tests, rust/, lichen/tests. C beacon scheduler otherwise conforms (60s/300s, coap_location.h + test_stationary_and_moving_intervals_with_hysteresis). Placement: C coap_location.c interval gate (vectors ready), Python/Rust beacon senders.
